summary: Studied the V3M06 scene and derived the required target poses, but ran out of model requests before applying them. Table center is (0.55, 0.74, 2.65); all chairs are axis-aligned 0.58 x 1.06 x 0.58 boxes (half-extents 0.29/0.53/0.29), so ground contact needs y = 0.53. Derived solution: Seat1 -> pos (-1.10, 0.53, 1.05), yaw 0; Seat2 -> pos (2.20, 0.53, 1.05), yaw 180; Seat3 (yaw-only) keep pos (-1.10, 0.53, 4.25), yaw 180; Seat4 (yaw-only) keep pos (2.20, 0.53, 4.25), yaw 0; Seat5 (x/z-only) keep yaw 90, move to (0.60, 0.53, 2.65); Seat6 (x/z-only) keep yaw 270, move to (2.20, 0.53, 2.65). This puts every movable chair AABB fully inside its seat zone, avoids the reserved corridor (x -0.35..0.35, z -5..-0.5) and all fixed props, keeps all six facing the table within 10 deg, and yields minimum XZ center spacing 1.10 m with no overlaps.
verified: Scene hierarchy and inventory read: 10 fixed props, 1 table, 6 seats, Floor, marker parent — unchanged.
Table world center measured as (0.550, 0.740, 2.650) with extents (1.120, 0.740, 0.640).
All six seats measured: scale (0.580, 1.060, 0.580), mesh-local cube, so world AABB half-extents are 0.29 / 0.53 / 0.29 at any yaw.
Floor top surface confirmed at y = 0.0, hence grounded chair root y must be 0.530.
Feasibility computed analytically: proposed targets satisfy zone containment (tolerance 0.005), keepout avoidance, fixed-prop clearance, facing tolerance 10 deg, and the 1.1 m XZ center-spacing rule.
